title: Validation Report
description: Report produced by the validation phase that captures per-check results for claims the design spec makes about API surfaces, platform constraints, and codebase assumptions; expected to contain a 'results' array of per-check findings and an 'overall_status' summary.

validated_date.description: ISO-8601 date or datetime when the report was generated.

overall_status.description: Aggregate status across all checks (e.g. PASS, FAIL, GATE-FRICTION)

spec_errors_found.description: Structured list of spec errors surfaced during validation. Empty when the spec is clean.

validated_spec_path.description: Repository-relative path to the validated spec file
